neoecoae.configuration.calculating.toolt: ECO crafting calculation and dispatch diagnostics.
neoecoae.configuration.computationSystem:
Maximum length (in blocks) allowed for the Computation System multiblock.
Higher values allow longer expansions but may increase structure check cost.
neoecoae.configuration.craftingPatternBu:
Number of pattern pages exposed by one ECO smart pattern bus.
Each page stores 63 encoded patterns.
neoecoae.configuration.craftingSystemMax:
Maximum length (in blocks) allowed for the Crafting System multiblock.
Higher values allow longer expansions but may increase structure check cost.
neoecoae.configuration.debug.tooltip: Troubleshooting options. Keep these disabled during normal play.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoCpuPushTickLim:
Maximum normal crafting pattern pushes a CPU may attempt per tick.
Ordinary fallback is capped at 64 per CPU per tick; a lower limit can be configured.
This is independent of co-processors and previous ticks.
The configuration ceiling is 393216. Fast Path batches do not consume this limit.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoCraftSubmissio: Enable ECO Craft Submission Detail Logs

Diagnose why the crafting-confirm Start button is unavailable or why submission is delayed or fails.
Includes Start-button state, plan and CPU selection, submission route and elapsed time.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoCraftingOutput:
Log one aggregated warning per crafting job after its workers have been unable to deliver outputs for 200 ticks, then every 1200 ticks.
A recovery message is logged when the wait ends.
This option only controls logging and never changes output ownership, retry or recovery behavior.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoDispatchWatchd:
Log ECO dispatch candidate reasons and task accounting before and after dispatch.
Also logs an aggregated diagnostic after 200 ticks without real progress, then every 1200 ticks.
This option only collects diagnostics and does not change crafting state.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoFastPathCacheS: Maximum recipe entries kept in each ECO fast path cache.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoPlanningMaxMem:
Estimated retained memory budget in MiB for cycle matrices and search states.
Exceeding the budget leaves the result unresolved.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoPlanningMaxMil:
Shared cooperative time budget in milliseconds for one ECO planning session, including routes, startup seeds and craft-less probes.
Exceeding the budget leaves the result unresolved.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoPlanningMaxWor:
Shared checkpoint work budget for one ECO planning session.
Changing routes or startup seeds does not reset it.
neoecoae.configuration.ecoPlanningStageD: Enable ECO Fast Planning Stage Logs

Log every ECO fast-planning calculation stage, including acyclic and cyclic planning.
Also logs whether each request selects ECO fast planning or the native AE2 planner, and why.
Includes stage duration, success state, failure reason, target item and requested amount.
neoecoae.configuration.fastPath.tooltip:
ECO AE2 fast path cache and batch crafting limits.
Fast Path is enabled by default and falls back to single-craft execution when Post Crafting Event is enabled.
neoecoae.configuration.infiniteMigration: Maximum number of resource types each storage host migrates into infinite storage per tick.
Infinite Migration Time Budget (Microseconds per Tick)

Time each storage host may spend per tick migrating disks into infinite storage, in microseconds.
At least one resource is migrated per tick; the budget is shared by all drives in the same tick.
neoecoae.configuration.largeWorkstationI:
Compatible recipes are loaded by default. Leave this disabled to require the matching upgrade card.
Enable to unlock all supported compatible recipes without installing a card.
Native recipes and adapters without a dedicated card remain available. The blank card adds no recipe family.
Reopen the world or restart the server after changing this option.
neoecoae.configuration.largeWorkstationT:
Enabled by default. Disable temperature, preheating and overheat recovery to use coolant-based parallelism.
Enable overclock and active cooling: water / sodium / cryotheum provide 16,384 / 65,536 / 262,144 parallel; normal is 256.
Consumes 100 mB per advancing overclocked processing tick; all tiers use x1 recipe energy.
Reopen the world or restart the server after changing this option.
neoecoae.configuration.megaBulkAutoMarkT:
Amount threshold used when an ECO storage host automatically marks compressible items.
Only items with amounts strictly greater than this value are marked.
neoecoae.configuration.postCraftingEvent:
Post a vanilla crafting event (ItemCraftedEvent) when the Crafting System finishes a recipe.
May introduce extra event/listener overhead; can be more noticeable with mods like Balm installed.
neoecoae.configuration.storageSystemMaxL:
Maximum length (in blocks) allowed for the Storage System multiblock.
Higher values allow longer expansions but may increase structure check cost.

tooltip.neoecoae.computation_system_desc: The computation subsystem introduces virtual Crafting Processors (vCPUs):
The host provides only one vCPU to the ME network at a time, with capacity equal to all currently available bytes in the subsystem
When a user assigns a crafting task to a vCPU, the host automatically adjusts the vCPU's byte allocation to the task's requirements before assigning it to a Threading Core
New vCPUs can be allocated continuously until the total allocated vCPUs reach the max thread count
vCPUs are immediately destroyed when the crafting task completes and all items are returned
tooltip.neoecoae.computation_threading_c: Threading Core is the main part of the computation subsystem, providing thread count to the host controller
Threads determine the maximum virtual CPUs for the computation subsystem
When destroyed, compressed CPU data will be directly saved to the dropped item
